analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see stance for the past 3 sessions. RSI remains at 52.6 in neutral territory, and MACD histogram continues to worsen at 0.1660. keyPointsEn: RSI is holding in neutral territory at 52.6, but the MACD histogram continues to worsen at 0.1660, indicating a weak trend reversal signal.
A Higher Low pattern is forming as the 5-day low is higher than the 20-day low, leaving room for a technical bounce.
The weekly ADX shows a clear trend at 34.3, but the daily MACD worsening signal takes precedence, warranting a wait-and-see approach.
